verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents GlitchTip's own telemetry, usage tracking, or a setting to opt out of it. Self-hosting (docs-26), the EU-hosted instance (docs-24), and the MCP server's "no data sharing" claim (docs-9) are adjacent privacy features, not an opt-out control. The tracesSampleRate option (docs-23) governs the application data customers send to GlitchTip, which is the product's core function, not tracking of the user.
